description: Used in qsub for summing up usage values (?).
It contains some of the fields which can appear in the qacct -j job_id output.
See also the sge_accounting(5) man page.

attributes.name: host
description: Host where a job ran.

attributes.name: queue
description: Cluster queue in which a job ran.

attributes.name: group
description: Unix user group of the job owner.

attributes.name: owner
description: Unix user name of the job owner.

attributes.name: project
description: Project the job was running for.

attributes.name: department
description: The job owner's department.

attributes.name: ru_wallclock
description: Wallclock time from rusage (end time - start_time).

attributes.name: ru_utime
description: User CPU time from rusage.

attributes.name: ru_stime
description: System CPU time from rusage.

attributes.name: ru_maxrss
description: Maximum resident set size of the job's processes from rusage.

attributes.name: ru_inblock
description: Number of block input operations from rusage.

attributes.name: granted_pe
description: In case of a parallel job: The PE the job was running in.

attributes.name: slots
description: The number of slots the job occupied.

attributes.name: cpu
description: The cpu usage of the job reported by sge_execd in seconds.

attributes.name: mem
description: The integral memory usage of the job reported by sge_execd in Gbytes cpu seconds.

attributes.name: io
description: The IO usage of the job reported by sge_execd (the amount of data transferred in input and output operations.

attributes.name: iow
description: The amount of time the job waited for IO operations to happen as reported by sge_execd.

attributes.name: maxvmem
description: The maximum virtual memory usage of the job reported by sge_execd.

attributes.name: arid
description: The id of an advance reservation the job might have run in.
